subject: Structured performance conversation — launch plan and legal clearance
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Structured performance conversation — launch plan and legal clearance

Team —

Following our 1:1 earlier this week, I want to move forward with a structured performance conversation for Emily Chen (IC, Search infra). The objective is to provide a clear, documented coaching plan with measurable milestones and a defined review cadence. Before I speak with Emily, I need three things aligned:

1) A short manager-facing checklist I can share with Emily at the meeting so expectations are unambiguous.
2) HR sign-off on the timeline and documentation approach (consent form, private notes).
3) Legal check on language for potential future escalation (we want to avoid avoidable technicalities around performance definitions).

I've attached a first draft (structured_coaching_plan_v1.docx) and a one-page checklist (manager_guidance_checklist.xlsx). Please review and flag any concerns.

Proposed cadence: 8-week coaching plan, 30/60/8-week checkpoints, weekly 30-minute manager check-ins. I plan to run the initial conversation next Tuesday (7/22) late morning — if anyone has a blocking objection to timing or content, let me know by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: structured_coaching_plan_v1.docx (docx), manager_guidance_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structured performance conversation — launch plan and legal clearance

Thanks for the draft, Dylan — this looks like a good foundation. A few quick notes:

- I like the 8-week timeline but recommend we make the 30/60 checkpoints explicitly tied to deliverables (not just "progress") to keep it objective. I've put comments in the doc.
- For the initial conversation script, I'd add a short paragraph about support available (mentorship, pairing sessions, training budget) so it's not punitive in tone.
- HR: Emily should receive the consent form and a copy of the coaching plan after the meeting. Marissa, can you confirm the standard wording we should send?

I don't think outside counsel needs to be looped unless there's an active contractual/disciplinary risk. If Legal disagrees, we can brief them with a redacted summary.

I'll be available for a prep call Monday 9:00–9:30 AM. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Lauren
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Dylan — quick legal/precedent points from my side before you meet:

- Language: avoid phrases like "failure to meet expectations" without a clear mapping to role competencies. Instead, reference the specific behaviors and measurable outcomes (e.g., "missed two SLA targets for infra rollout, see metric X"). That reduces ambiguity if HR needs to refer back later.
- Documentation: keep notes factual, dated, and avoid subjective adjectives. If the employee raises accommodation or medical issues, pause and escalate to HR immediately.
- Timing: 8 weeks is reasonable, but consider a formal checkpoint at week 4 for an early assessment — that helps us surface a possible immediate improvement or a need for escalation earlier.

I've attached a redline snippet in the Drive link and flagged preferred wording in the doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qx-hr-coaching-templates

I do not think we need outside counsel unless this becomes a termination path. If you want, I can draft a concise "manager script" paragraph you can use verbatim in the meeting.

-Markus
General Counsel (interim)
Redwood Inference

Dylan — HR reviewed the materials. Confirmations and guidance below:

- Consent/process: please use the attached employee_consent_form.pdf during the meeting; have Emily sign a digital copy afterwards. That preserves an audit trail.
- Tone & support language: approved. We added a paragraph listing coaching resources (mentor, training stipend, weekly pairing) to the document stored on Drive.
- Documentation retention: HR will keep an internal private file (HR-TICKET-1017). Manager notes should be factual; summaries will be uploaded to the HR ticket.

One operational note: if the employee requests an accommodation or references a protected condition, stop the coaching flow and escalate to Marissa immediately.

I've uploaded the finalized consent form and a redlined coaching plan to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qx-hr-coaching-templates
